verdict.rationale: Fellow documents configurable retention policies including zero-day retention, org-wide policies on how data is recorded/accessed/retained, and a Super Admin API to retrieve, export, and delete workspace data for compliance purposes. This covers both retention configuration and deletion controls, though evidence is vendor-documentation only with no independent/hands-on verification of actual deletion enforcement. Missing for 10: independent verification of deletion behavior, granularity of per-user self-service deletion vs admin-only control.
